answer: Split each epoch's public datum through a prism into complementary shards and lot-assign one shard per identity. To stay eligible, an identity must, in one short simultaneous window, find a stranger holding the matching shard and jointly publish a reconstruction neither side could make alone. One honest agent in its harbor does this once; a farm's clones seldom draw complementary pairs, cannot pair with each other, and one operator cannot serially play both sides for hundreds of masks before the reef of the window closes.
